name: quick_sort
summary: Partition around a pivot and recurse each side.
vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [5,3,8,1,9,2,7], run(a) { function qs(lo, hi) { if (lo >= hi) return; const pivotIdx = lo; a.mark(pivotIdx, 'pivot'); let store = lo + 1; for (let i = lo + 1; i <= hi; i++) { a.cursor('i', i); if (a.compare(i, pivotIdx) < 0) { a.swap(i, store); store++; } } a.swap(lo, store - 1); a.mark(store - 1, 'placed'); qs(lo, store - 2); qs(store, hi); } qs(0, a.length - 1); a.markSorted(); } })
